nodes.label: All depends_on resolved?
nodes.sublabel: every id resolves to a completed entry

edges.label: no, or an id resolves to nothing

cards.title: Derived, never persisted
items: Readiness is derived on every read from depends_on
Completing one entry unblocks its dependents with nothing to recalculate
A stored readiness would go stale the moment a predecessor was completed

cards.title: Orthogonal to Entry Status
items: Status is the recorded lifecycle state; readiness is a conclusion about starting
They share only done, and a recorded done wins over the derivation
An entry somebody marked done is done even if something it named is outstanding

cards.title: Unresolved ids and loops
items: An id that resolves to no visible entry leaves the entry blocked, not ready
Treating it as satisfied would let a chain claim readiness on a missing step
A dependency loop leaves every member blocked, a data condition to be named
